feature: PATCH_008: price-basis check after the comparison premise book. comparison/price_basis.py (new, no tkinter) decides the load-time price-basis state. Recalculated copies of ONE premise book were still warned as 'not priced on the same basis' because 01 Planning tags a copy that keeps method-dependent items (concrete, reinforcing steel, formwork, phenolic foam) on the regional database 'mixed_comparison_group_and_regional_database' and one that keeps them on AI rates 'comparison_group_premise_book'; the book leaves those items to each Project by design. Such copies now get an information dialog that lists every Project's own-price items and their origin (regional/AI); originals, copies of different book versions, a copy mixed with an original and a copy still priced on the source basis keep the warning. The warning now lists the regionally priced items and the five-step tab 7 procedure (list -> decide -> create copies -> 01 Planning Module 5 -> 02 Evaluation Modules 6/7 -> reload). Tab 7 lists B/D showed only buildings 1-3 of the 2-7 loaded; they now show all seven, with a horizontal scrollbar. No value is rewritten; 01 Planning is unchanged. Includes PATCH_007 and earlier.
